prompt: A single panoramic illustration contrasts a small left-hand inset of a person still typing every prompt to a chatbot that merely replies in speech bubbles against a larger central scene in which the same language-model core, given the ordinary-language goal of opening a store, hiring staff and turning a profit, is wired by cables to a web browser, job board, email, company credit card and shop chat channel; around the core a looping cycle of plan-act-check-retry arrows shows the agent independently sending messages, spending money and changing other people’s working lives, while scattered details depict it drafting a policy then forgetting it, stalling until a human nudge, and recommending a firing that leaves a shadowed worker, with floating legal scales, a discarded rulebook and a question mark over who is responsible, making visually unmistakable that the system is not only talking but acting.
